Container.Name: isfdb-db
Container.Overview: MariaDB 10.11 holding a local copy of the ISFDB (Internet Speculative Fiction Database) dump for scraper-stack on Tower05. No published port: reachable only from containers on the default bridge. Root password is empty by design (local-only, no port exposed).

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: MariaDB data directory (about 3 GB). Keep on the SSD pool, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Dump folder
Config.Description: Where the ISFDB SQL dumps live for import.

Config.Name: MARIADB_ALLOW_EMPTY_ROOT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Empty root password (matches the original container). Only safe because no port is published.
